tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (the desk). Cool, near-white; never pure white so white surfaces lift off it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers, modals, the PDF page frame. Maps to shadcn --card and --popover.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover rows, table headers, sidebar active item, inset wells. Never text-bearing beyond ink-muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, row dividers, separators. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, switches and unfilled buttons. 3:1 against surface and bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Harbor ink; 13:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table meta, helper text. 6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, captions. Lowest allowed text color; 4.5:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Harbor blue. Primary buttons, links, focus, selected state, progress. White text on it passes 4.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for 'Out for signature' badges, selected rows, info callouts.

tokens.name: brand-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-bg. 6.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative mid-tint: progress tracks, illustration fields, covers. Never carries text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed. Solid for icons, dots and check marks.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for Completed badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-bg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expired, expiring soon, needs attention. Solid for icons and dots.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for Expired badges and warning callouts.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Declined, errors, destructive actions. Solid for icons, destructive buttons, field errors.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for Declined badges and error callouts.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger-bg.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Draft and Voided. Solid for icons and dots.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for Draft and Voided badges.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on neutral-bg.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring color: 2px ring with 2px offset on every focusable element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, sheets and the signature capture dialog.

tokens.name: signer-1
tokens.usage: Signer identity color 1 (orange). Fields, rail dot and row accent for that signer; always paired with the signer's name or initials.

tokens.name: signer-2
tokens.usage: Signer identity color 2 (teal-green).

tokens.name: signer-3
tokens.usage: Signer identity color 3 (rose).

tokens.name: signer-4
tokens.usage: Signer identity color 4 (ochre).

tokens.name: signer-5
tokens.usage: Signer identity color 5 (violet).

tokens.name: signer-6
tokens.usage: Signer identity color 6 (slate). Signer colors 7 to 10 in code (editor/reducer.ts) should be re-picked to stay clear of brand blue.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Signed documents, kept in the file itself.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title (h1). One per page. Replaces the copy-pasted clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.1rem).

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Row titles, dialog titles, form group labels (h3).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Waiting on Maria Okafor to sign.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, button labels, table cells that name something.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary text, helper text, table meta.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, field labels in the editor. Minimum text size in the product.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and activity log. Use sparingly.

spacing.note: 4px base. Page gutters 16 (mobile) / 24 / 32. Card padding space-5 or space-6. Stack related items at space-2 to space-3, sections at space-6 to space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly related items; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (vertical), row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (horizontal), mobile page gutter, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding, desktop page gutter, section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing page section spacing.

radius.note: Set shadcn --radius to 0.5rem (radius-md); radius-sm and radius-lg derive from it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small chips, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, rows. Default control radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, document sheets, popovers. Replaces rounded-[0.9rem].

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets, the signature capture dialog. Replaces rounded-2xl.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, signer color dots, pill toggles.

shadow.note: Mostly borders, not shadows. Shadows only on things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that need a hint of lift (dashboard summary). Default cards use border only.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, the floating field toolbar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the drag overlay.
